question.problem:
From the information given below, find all of the angles that are congruent.

$$
\begin{aligned}m∠A & ={30}^{∘}, \\ m∠B & ={150}^{∘}, \\ m∠C & ={180}^{∘}, \\ m∠D & ={180}^{∘}-m∠C, \\ m∠E & ={120}^{∘}+m∠A, \\ m∠F & =m∠E.\end{aligned}
$$

current_example.problem:
From the information given below, find all of the angles that are congruent.

$$
\begin{aligned}m∠A & ={10}^{∘}, \\ m∠B & ={40}^{∘}, \\ m∠C & ={80}^{∘}, \\ m∠D & ={90}^{∘}-m∠C, \\ m∠E & =m∠B.\end{aligned}
$$
current_example.worked_solution:
First, let's find the measures of $\angle D$ and $\angle E\mathbin{:}$

$$
\begin{aligned}m∠D & ={90}^{∘}-m∠C \\  & ={90}^{∘}-{80}^{∘} \\  & ={10}^{∘} \\  \\ m∠E & =m∠B \\  & ={40}^{∘}\end{aligned}
$$

So, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}m∠A & ={10}^{∘} \\ m∠B & ={40}^{∘} \\ m∠C & ={80}^{∘} \\ m∠D & ={10}^{∘} \\ m∠E & ={40}^{∘}\end{aligned}
$$

We have that $m \angle A = m \angle D$ and $m \angle B = m \angle E.$

Therefore, $\angle A \cong \angle D$ and $\angle B \cong \angle E.$
